no_override: This launcher has no selectable models. It will start with its own settings.
one_start: This model choice applies to this start only.
model_changed: The selected model is no longer available. Choose again.
harness_changed: This launcher now starts a different harness. Choose again.
no_launchers: This computer has no available launchers.
launcher_unavailable: This launcher cannot start a session on the selected computer right now.
offline: The computer is offline. Your draft is kept. Options will be checked when it reconnects.
remove_attachments: This launcher cannot send attachments with the first message. Remove them or choose another launcher.
